faqs.q: Does Priority Roofing offer free roof inspections in Houston?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer free roof inspections, especially after storms in Houston, to assess any damage and help you plan your next steps.

faqs.q: How often should I have my roof inspected?
faqs.a: Priority Roofing recommends checking your roof at least twice a year, particularly after storms or if you spot any damage.

It is hard to know who to trust, so we encourage homeowners to ask questions. Your roofer should know the ins and outs of the roof and the insurance process. Check reviews, because the best way to vet a company is to see what other people's experiences are. And look for credentials: choose a company that holds the top certifications from the manufacturers whose products you will be installing.

services.title: Roof Replacement
services.short: A full replacement, step by step, with a labor warranty.
services.text: Still dealing with leaks after repairs, or higher energy bills? Priority Roofing makes residential roof replacement straightforward, with a range of quality materials to match your home.
services.imageAlt: A new shingle roof over the gables of a brick home
body: Still dealing with roof leaks after repairs, or higher energy bills? It might be time for a replacement. With years of local expertise we offer efficient service and a range of quality materials to find the match for your home.

We understand that installing a new roof can seem like a daunting task, but our friendly team of experts is here to support you every step of the way. The benefits homeowners tell us about are reduced utility expenses, an increase in home value and a lower insurance premium, alongside the 10 year labor warranty and no-leak guarantee.
points: Tear off: we remove all existing layers of shingles
Decking: up to three sheets replaced at no additional cost
Underlayment: synthetic, a 100 percent waterproof barrier rather than #15 felt
Starter strip around the perimeter, with a lifetime and 110 mph wind warranty
Valley protection: GAF Ice and Water Shield, peel and stick and self sealing
Dura Flo pipe flashings, carrying a 35 year manufacturer warranty
Ventilation sized to the NFVA your home needs
Yard cleanup with a magnetic toolbar once we finish

faqs.q: Does Priority Roofing offer warranties on its work?
faqs.a: Yes. Priority Roofing offers warranties, including both manufacturer warranties on materials and labor warranties on installation. You can receive warranty options ranging from 10 to 25 years, depending on the chosen roofing system.

faqs.q: How do I know my roof is damaged?
faqs.a: We show you photo documentation of any damage on your property, and make sure you are aware of the current parameters set by insurance companies to qualify for a totaled roof.

services.title: Designer Roofing
services.short: Slate, clay tile, synthetic, shake, standing seam and stone-coated steel.
services.text: Priority Designer restores century-old slate and clay tile, installs lightweight systems like Brava, and does custom copper work.
services.imageAlt: A large home with a slate-style roof and multiple gables
body: Whether you have a 100-year-old slate or clay tile roof in need of restoration, you are building a new home with a lightweight system like Brava, or you want custom copper work to make a statement, Priority Designer has the knowledge to guide you through your project.

In addition to asphalt shingles, our Houston branch offers designer roofing inspection, repair and replacement backed by the finest products and reputable certifications, including GAF, NRCA, UASRC and OSHA, along with our labor warranties.

We also offer free annual inspections on a designer roof, which are the easiest way to be sure your investment is in good condition. We perform them at no cost, usually by drone so the roof takes no further damage, and send you a full engineer's report on its condition. Slate and clay tile are the roofs we concentrate on for these annual inspections.
points: Free annual inspections, usually by drone, with a full engineer's report
Slate and clay tile restoration on century-old roofs
Custom copper work
Slate, a natural stone roof that often exceeds a century with proper maintenance
Clay tile, with a lifespan beyond 50 years and minimal maintenance
Synthetic, engineered polymers that replicate slate, wood or clay tile
Shake, usually cedar, resistant to decay and insects for over 30 years
Standing seam metal, 40 to 70 years, watertight and energy efficient
Stone-coated steel, 40 to 70 years, in styles matching tile, slate or shingle

Priority Roofing is family-owned, and local management and production teams run more than 30 locations. Our Houston branch is dedicated to delivering exceptional customer service and exceptional workmanship, and we offer some of the best warranties in the roofing industry.

At Priority we don't chase storms, we help restore the communities that we live in. As the roofing company in Houston, we take pride in our quality, integrity and transparency, and we are licensed and insured.
